author: Colin and Samir
description:
Raj Shamani just became the most-subscribed podcast on YouTube, passing Diary of a CEO and Joe Rogan. We sat down with the host of Figuring Out to learn how he got there, from selling dish soap to building India’s biggest show.

0:00 Intro
2:13 How Raj turned a Huberman interview into 17M views
6:32 Why India is the next great creator market
13:33 3 lessons from selling soap that apply to YouTube
22:49 Raj's origin story: scaling his dad's soap business
31:07 Rickshaws, Venice Beach & the power of thinking small
37:44 From soap to content: failed podcasts & 400 Reels in 90 days
43:58 Find your edge (and Raj's 1.6B-view clipping machine)
48:12 From 300K followers to India's #1 podcast
56:39 Insecurity + aspiration: what to promise your audience
1:05:14 Colin on imposter syndrome
1:09:02 Raj's "not-to-do" list & why brands pay more for it
1:13:32 How a 150-person creator business makes money
1:16:50 How creators should think about India: escaping the RPM trap
1:23:35 India's creative bo
title: The New King of Podcasts
